test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He ______ all the autumn leaves.
solution: The correct answer is **"gathered."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Gathered"** means to collect or bring together. ((व्‍यक्तियों का) इकट्ठा या एकत्र होना) • **Example**: *A crowd soon **gathered**__ at the scene of the accident.* • It is the most appropriate option in the context of the sentence, as it makes sense for someone to gather autumn leaves. • The past tense of **"gather"** is **"gathered"**, which is the form needed in this sentence. • So, the correct answer is Option 1. ​ **Correct sentence**: *He __**gathered**__ all the autumn leaves.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Garnished"** means to decorate or embellish food. (भोजन को अन्‍य खाद्य पदार्थ की अल्‍प मात्रा से सजाना) • **"Smothered"** means to suffocate or cover completely. ((कपड़े से मुँह ढकते हुए) दम घोंट कर मार डालना) • **"Withered"** means to dry up or lose vitality. ((पौधों का) मुरझा जाना, कुम्‍हला जाना; पौधे को सुखाकर मार देना, मुरझा देना) 1b4:Tb68, The correct answer is **"Rude."**
